messages:
ash: Quick brain dump: customers keep asking for a fast "escape hatch" when v2 behaves differently on a small subset of requests. Idea: a Console + API "compat-override" that lets a tenant mark a single request (or a small % via header) to be routed to v1 while the rest use v2. This would be visible in audit logs and rate-limited. Thoughts?

meera: neat. Two immediate asks: 1) must be explicit in API (X-Redwood-Compat: v1) and only allowed for authenticated service keys; 2) Console should show an easy toggle and audit trail with reason field.

tony: infra caveat: if clients bulk-enable overrides we could fragment routing and hurt perf. Require a per-tenant cap (e.g., 0.5% by default) and a hard max (e.g., 5%). Also emit an internal metric compat_override_volume for autoscaling.

ash: implementation sketch:
- API: accept header X-Redwood-Compat: v1 or v2-request-id for single-request override
- Console: small "compat override" quick-action in route detail to enable a header-generating token and set per-key caps
- Audit: every override logged with user, route, reason, and request_id in tenant audit log
- Billing: overrides counted normally for tokens but flagged so CS can filter; optional probe_bucket mode if tenant opts-in to non-billable testing

ops-bot: ops-bot: feature flag staged: feature.api.compat_override.enabled -> canary-ops + staging

meera: policy: disallow auto-unpin or bulk migrating pinned routes using the override token. It's for short-lived debugging or progressive rollouts only. Also require an expiry TTL on any console-generated override tokens.

tony: add safety: if compat_override_volume / tenant_traffic > threshold OR cluster pool usage increases rapidly, auto-disable new override tokens and notify ops. Also add a sampling header for telemetry: X-Compat-Override-Sampled=true so we can correlate traces.

billing-bot: billing-bot: note: if we support a non-billable probe bucket for overrides, billing ingestion must ignore those tokens. Add flag feature.api.compat_override.probe_bucket = boolean. We'll need to update billing rules.

ash: UI copy for Console quick-action: "Generate compat override token (routes matching this key will route to v1 for debug). Tokens expire after 24h. Rate-limited by tenant cap. Overrides are logged and visible in audit." Tooltip: "Use for targeted rollback of individual failing requests; not intended for bulk migration."

meera: telemetry additions: per-route compat_override_rate, compat_override_success_delta, compat_override_cost_delta_usd so CS can find patterns. Also an "override-alert" if success_delta >5% negative impact.

tony: runbook: if we see abuse or capacity issues -> disable feature.api.compat_override.enabled, revoke all active tokens, set per-tenant caps to 0, and contact affected tenants. Also add a cleanup job to expire old tokens and ensure audit index retention is limited for compliance.

ash: I'll open a small PR with API spec, console wireframe, and minimal flag contract:
feature.api.compat_override.enabled = boolean
feature.api.compat_override.default_cap_pct = 0.005
feature.api.compat_override.hard_max_pct = 0.05
feature.api.compat_override.probe_bucket = boolean
feature.api.compat_override.token_ttl_hours = 24

meera: please add an RBAC check so only specific roles can generate tokens (org-admins + devops by default). Also include a CS-facing CSV export of override events.

ash: will do. tagging @meera @tony. PR incoming.
